BiblicalUsage: Malkuth is the kingdom, the rule, the dominion, and it is the word for God's reign over all. 1 Chronicles 17:14 promises David's son shall be settled in God's house and in His kingdom for ever, and Psalms 103:19 says the LORD hath prepared His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom ruleth over all. Psalms 145:13 says Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is the anchor of every other promise: a kingdom that rules over all cannot be shaken by any king under it. My position is that 1 Chronicles 17:14 is the thread from David to Christ, because the kingdom settled for ever is the one His Son inherits.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; God's Sovereignty; Promise
